name: feedback-triage
description: Daily Beeline feedback sweep; steps: feedback-triage-steps
summary: Report merged fixes, rank new feedback, ask a person, and open fix corners.

notify.does: Tell reporters about fixes that merged since the last run.

pull.does: Read new feedback and rank it by problem.

approve.does: A person approves dispatching the ranked problems, or skips them.

dispatch.does: Open a fix corner for each approved problem.

failed.does: The sweep stopped before it finished.
